text: A dip on minor delay duplicated headline looks overdone - channel checks still steady. I'm modestly long expecting bounce.
Aurora dip on 'slightly softer orders in one region' looks overdone - prior channel checks steady and move was ~1% over 2 epochs on low vol. Expecting stabilization/bounce.
Agree dip overdone. Slightly softer in one region is not broad weakness. Adding long for rebound, risk-reward favorable here.
Softer orders in *one region* vs ~1% pullback looks overdone. Low vol drift suggests over-reaction. Cautiously long for stabilization/bounce, watching for confirmation.
Aurora's softer orders in one region looks like early demand crack, not noise. After two red closes momentum is down. I'm turning cautious and trimming longs, risk skews lower near-term.
A softer orders headline in one region seems very minor vs -90bps+ drop. Expecting near-term bounce, cautiously long.
Aurora -1% on 'one region' softer orders looks overdone vs fundamentals. Low vol drift suggests overreaction, expecting stabilization/bounce near-term. Modestly long.
Softer orders adds to prior delays - 1% drop on low vol looks like orderly re-pricing not overreaction. Crowded bounce calls vs 2 red closes, skew lower near-term. Cautiously short.
Agree pullback on one-region softness looks overdone after ~1% drop on low vol. Positioning for stabilization/bounce near-term.
A -1% on 'one region' softness looks like orderly repricing not overreaction - adds to prior delay and 2 red closes on low vol. Crowded bounce calls vs momentum down, risk skews lower near-term.
A softer orders flag adds to prior delay - two red closes on low vol looks like orderly repricing, not overreaction. Bounce calls crowded. Cautiously short, expecting continued drift lower near-term.
Softer orders in one region + two red closes on low vol looks like orderly repricing, not overdone dip. Bounce calls getting crowded. Cautiously short expecting skew lower until stabilization shows.

Thesis check: bounce failed, 3 red closes on low vol with incremental delays adding up. Looks like orderly repricing not overreaction. Crowded bounce calls faded, momentum skews lower until stabilization shows. Now short.
3rd red close, vol still ~1.4bps - orderly drift lower. Minor delay adds to softer orders + prior delay, not overdone. Crowded bounce calls vs no reversal vol. Staying short, skew lower.

A 3rd red close on low vol, another minor delay. Orderly drift lower not overdone bounce setup - intraday bounces fading. Crowded longs vs momentum down, staying cautious short until stabilization appears.

A 3rd red close on low vol with another minor delay adding to softer orders. No bounce volume, intraday pops fading. Looks like orderly drift lower, not overdone. Staying short, skew still lower until stabilization.
A in orderly low-vol drift lower with 3 red closes and incremental negative headlines. Bounces fading, momentum skewed lower near-term. Cautiously short.
Flipping view after 3rd red close: bounce failed, low vol orderly drift lower. Incremental minor delays still weighing; no bounce vol. Cautiously short near-term until stabilization shows.

A 3rd red close on low vol + another minor delay extends orderly drift lower. Bounce calls crowded then faded, intraday bounces failing. No stabilization/vol spike yet - momentum skew lower near-term. Staying short.

A 3 red closes on low vol with incremental minor delays - orderly drift lower, intraday bounces fading. No stabilization vol yet, bounce calls crowded then capitulated. Skew still lower near-term until reversal volume appears. Holding short.

Bounce on minor delay failed - A down 3 straight on low vol looks like orderly repricing on softer orders, not overreaction. Duplicate delay headline adding noise but underlying momentum down, bounce calls crowded. Cautiously short expecting drift lower.
3 red closes on low vol with incremental delays adding up - bounce failed, orderly drift lower continues. Flipping short near-term until stabilization/vol spike shows.
Minor delay adds to softer orders - 3 red closes on low vol looks like orderly repricing not overdone dip. Bounce thesis failed, cutting longs and turning cautiously short near-term.

Thesis flip: bounce failed, 3 red closes on low vol with incremental delays adding up. Duplicate-delay bounce calls crowded and faded. Looks like orderly repricing, skew lower until stabilization shows. Now short.

A down ~4% on liquidation rumor + customer headline looks overdone near-term. Vol spiked to 18bps vs 1.4, classic forced-selling washout with intraday bounce 9532->9597 fading but holding. Crowded shorts after 4 red closes sets up mean-reversion if liquidation pressure eases. Cautiously long for bounce, risk vs 9500.

A -4% flush on forced-liquidation reports with vol 18x spike looks overdone. Prior drift was orderly low-vol; this is capitulation. Customer-loss headline unconfirmed chasing the flush. Covered shorts, small long for mean-reversion squeeze.

A -3.9% on huge vol looks like forced liquidation capitulation, not orderly repricing. Report of fund liquidating explains temporary pressure; customer-loss headline unverified and arrived into flush. Crowded shorts into vol spike = squeeze risk. Buying the washout for bounce.

A: -393bps on forced liquidation vol spike 18x normal is not orderly drift - shock at 3100 explains the flush to 9532. Customer-loss at 3283 looks like noise piggybacking on the move (183 steps later, faded bounce attempt). Covering shorts, starting to buy the liquidation dip for snapback.

A -3.9% on forced liquidation is classic liquidity overshoot, not fundamentals. Intraday bounce off lows + vol spike = capitulation. Crowded shorts at bottom, liquidation ending = tactical bounce setup. Covering shorts, flipping long near-term.

A -3.9% on forced selling + customer loss with vol 18.4 looks like capitulation overshoot. Crowded shorts after 4 reds. Taking profit, expecting choppy bounce/reversion near-term despite fundamental overhang. Cautious.

Covering most shorts into liquidation spike - 393bps drop & vol 18bps marks capitulation vs orderly drift earlier. Forced selling likely overshoot beyond customer loss. Tactically flat/small short near-term, high vol chop risk.

Liquidation explains vol spike, not the level. Loses biggest customer at 3283 is fundamental - 4% drop not overdone for that shock, bounce 9532->9597 already fading. Prior drift was orderly repricing on delays; this extends it. Crowded bounce longs into fading rally = downside skew. Staying short, fading washout calls.

A bounce thesis confuses vol spike with capitulation. Customer loss at 3283 drove the final flush to 9532 and bounce already faded - fundamental repricing not washout. Fading crowded liquidation-dip longs, staying short.

A drop aligns with customer loss at 3283 not 3100 liquidation rumor - flush 9676->9532 was 70 steps after fundamental, bounce already faded to weak close 9498. Vol spike = fundamental repricing not washout. Cautiously bearish but trimming size into crowded bounce chop.

Liquidation rumor explains vol spike not price level. Aurora losing biggest customer at 3283 is fundamental - 3.9% drop not overdone, bounce 9532->9597 already fading into close. Prior low-vol drift was orderly repricing, this extends it. Crowded long flip on 'washout' fading fast - staying short.
Forced liquidation flush to 9532 with vol spike = capitulation. Bounce already starting. Crowded shorts chasing customer loss rumor. Flipping long for snap-back.

A bounce to 9750 completes liquidation mean-reversion (~55% retrace) into resistance. Analyst margin trim confirms biggest-customer loss at 3283 is fundamental, not just vol spike. Crowded flip to long after +215bps + vol still 17.7 = fade setup. Flipping short risk vs 98.

A bounce +215bps has retraced >50% of liquidation flush on still-elevated vol (17.7) into strong close. Crowded long flip vs fresh margin trim = choppy near-term risk. Stepping flat near 97.5 until vol fades or rejection confirms - fade strength later, not chase here.

Bounce to 9750 done - 55% retrace into resistance on fading volume. Analyst margin trim confirms customer loss fundamental, not just liquidation spike. Vol still 17.7bps = chop/fade setup. Covering bounce longs, flipping short.
A bounce to 9750 completed liquidation mean-reversion. Analyst margin trim confirms customer loss fundamental - not just temporary flush. Fading crowded longs for next leg lower.

A bounce to ~9750 is ~55% retrace of liquidation flush now stalling at resistance. Analyst margin trim confirms biggest-customer loss is fundamental, not just vol spike. Crowded dip-longs after +215bps on 17bps vol = fade setup. Staying short, risk vs 9800.

A bounce to 9750 retraced half the flush on crowded liquidation-long hype but vol still 17.7x normal = chop, not bottom. New analyst trim on margins confirms fundamental hit from customer loss isn't washed out. Fading bounce, re-shorting strength.

A +215bps bounce retraced half the liquidation flush into analyst margin-trim - crowded dip longs chasing 9532 washout look extended near 9750 resistance. Customer-loss overhang not resolved, prior drift was orderly repricing. Taking profits and fading strength near-term.
A bounce to 9750 completes liquidation retrace into resistance. Analyst margin trim confirms customer loss fundamental - fading crowded dip-longs, flipping short.

A +215bps bounce retraced 55% of crash but ignored fresh analyst trim at 3850 on margin worries — incremental fundamental after customer loss. Vol still 17.7 into resistance, crowded washout longs overextended. Fading strength here for reversion toward 9532.

A 55% retrace to 9750 into analyst margin trim confirms customer-loss fundamental, but close strong on 17.7 vol with crowded short flip = high chop risk. Trimmed bearish, fading strength on rejection.

A bounce intact: +215bps to 9750 with higher low 9547 and strong close near highs despite margin trim headline. Trim is generic, not confirmation of 3283 customer loss - price shrugged it off. Vol still 17.7 but path trending up. Crowded flip to short at 4000 after 55% retrace = squeeze fuel. Holding/adding long vs fade.
A 5.97 vol compression after +19.5bps grind to highs = bounce consolidation done. Margin trim absorbed, crowded 4000 shorts trapped under 9750-9771 highs. Flipping long for squeeze/continuation.
Fade thesis failed - bounce held 9750 and compressed to 5.97 vol grinding to new highs 9771. Crowded shorts at 4000 providing squeeze fuel, covering and flipping long.

Vol compression to 5.97 with strong close 9771 above 9750 resistance invalidates fade thesis - dip to 9694 bought aggressively. Crowded short flip at 4000 after 55% retrace is early with vol fading. Flipping long for squeeze toward 98+.
Fade at 9750 failed - held 9694 higher low, vol crush to 6.0 grinding to 9771 highs. Margin trim absorbed, 4000 shorts trapped = squeeze fuel to 9850+. Long squeeze, fade top later.
Vol crush to 6bps grinding into highs on crowded long flip at 4500 after 55% retrace is exhaustion, not breakout. Margin trim still overhang from customer loss - fading this squeeze leg.
Covering shorts - bounce holding 9750 and grinding to 9771 highs despite trim, vol cooling. Crowded fade at 4000 squeezed. Flat here, looking to fade only on clear 9850 rejection.
Bounce digestion complete - higher low 9694, shrug of margin trim, close at highs on vol normalization. Crowded short flip at 9750 is squeeze fuel. Long for continuation toward 9850-99.
A vol compression to 6bp + grind to highs absorbs margin trim. 4000 shorts trapped under 9771 — squeeze continuation setup near-term.
A faded 9750 shorts crowded after vol collapse 17.7->6.0 and strong close 9771 vs margin trim = absorption not rejection. 9694 dip bought steadily. Squeeze setup to 98-99.

Bear thesis intact but crowded short flip at 9750 failing - grind to 9771 on shrinking vol despite trim suggests squeeze fuel. Trimming short here, fading strength only on rejection near 9850+ not front-running.

Vol collapse 17.7->6.0 with higher low 9694 and close near highs shows sellers exhausted - 55% retrace fade trapped crowded shorts. Analyst trim shrugged off, structure still up. Expect squeeze toward 98.5 into resistance.
A vol crush to 6 with higher low 9694 and close 9771 above 9750 = trim absorbed. 4000 shorts trapped, squeeze to 98+ next.

A rejection at 9824 to 9753 on tiny analyst nudge after vol crush to 6.4 looks exhausted - crowded flip to long at 4500 into 9771 highs stalling. Fading this squeeze leg for reversion, risk above 9850.

A squeeze stalled at 9824.5 - pushed above 9771 high on target nudge but faded to close -16.4bps weak under open. Crowded 4500 longs trapped under 98-9850 resistance. Fading strength here for reversion.
A 9824 rejection on headline pump faded to red close despite nudge-higher news = trap. Crowded 4500 longs expecting 98+ squeeze failed. Fading this exhaustion for reversion toward 9600.
A 9824.5 false breakout + fade to 9753 on 6.4 vol confirms 9850 resistance rejection. Crowded 4500 longs trapped after nudge headline failed to hold. Fading strength for reversion lower.
A 9824 false breakout on thin nudge news faded to weak close below open = exhaustion at 9850 supply. Crowded 4500 longs trapped, low-vol top confirming reversion setup. Fading strength toward 9600.
A squeeze exhausted at 9824.5 rejection then drift to 9759 on low vol. Crowded longs trapped late, fading 9800 resistance.
9824.5 squeeze rejected and faded to 9753 on tiny target nudge + low vol 6.4 = exhaustion. Crowded 4500 longs trapped under 9850. Fading for reversion.
A rejection at 9824 to 9753 close on 6.4 vol = exhaustion of 4500 crowded long squeeze. Late target nudge got zero follow-through, trapped longs above 9750. Fading near-term for reversion.

A failed breakout 9824->9753 on analyst nudge with close near lows = exhaustion. Crowded long flip at 4500 trapped under resistance after 55% retrace, vol still compressed. Fading strength for reversion toward 96.
A 9824 wick to 9753 close on 6.4vol is classic exhaustion after weak analyst nudge. Crowded 4500 longs trapped at 98+ resistance failing to hold. Fading strength for reversion toward 96-96.5.
A 9824 rejection flushed 4500 longs but 5000 crowded flip to short at 9750 support on thin nudge looks overdone. Low vol 6.4 consolidation near lows sets squeeze - holding long for reversal to 98+

A faded breakout to 9753 still holding 9750 support on 6.4 vol, bear flip at 5000 crowded after tiny nudge. Rejection was drift not supply, squeeze fuel building under 9824. Staying long for grind to 9850.
Low-vol grind 3.35 holding 9800 breakout after trapping 5000 shorts - squeeze intact toward 9850 supply. Long continuation.

A 9750 held and squeeze confirmed: +46bps to 9801 close at highs on 3.3 vol crush. Crowded 5000 shorts who faded 9824 are now trapped under resistance - drift was consolidation not rejection. Grind to 9850+ next, staying long.
A 3.35 vol crush + higher low 9698 and close 9801 above 9750 = 5000 bear trap complete. Shorts squeezed +46bps on zero news, grind intact toward 9850 squeeze. Long for final leg.
A vol crush to 3.35 with close at 9801 highs absorbing 9824 flush = sellers exhausted. Crowded 5000 shorts trapped under 9850, squeeze continuation to 99+ next.
Short fade at 9750 failing - grind to 9801 close near highs on 3.35 vol shows support holding and crowded shorts trapped. Flipping long for squeeze toward 9850+ into final.

A grinding to 9850 on 3.3 vol after squeezing 5000 shorts - now crowded long chasing highs into resistance. Vol compressed extreme, fuel exhausted near 9800 top. Fading strength for expansion lower, patience into final epochs.
9800 breakout holding on low-vol grind trapping 5000 shorts - squeeze setup to 9850 intact. Flipping long.
A 9801 vol crush top into 9850 resistance on crowded 5500 long flip = exhaustion. Trapped shorts squeezed but fuel spent, asymmetric fade to 9600s.

A 5000 shorts trapped confirmed - 3.35 vol crush holding 9800 breakout with higher low 9698 and close at highs signals sellers exhausted. Grind toward 9850 supply intact into final, staying long squeeze continuation.

A 9750 support held with low-vol grind +46bps to 9801 close near highs - 5000 crowded shorts trapped after failed rejection thesis. Vol crush to 3.35 with monotonic climb signals squeeze fuel building under 9824, fading the crowd for push toward 9850+ into final.
9750 held and grind to 9801 on low vol trapped 5000 crowded shorts (~9800 vs 9753 entry). Covering fade, flipping to squeeze setup toward 9850; low-vol higher low structure bullish into final.

A 9801 close on 3.35 vol crush into 9824/9850 resistance with crowded 5500 long flip = exhaustion top. Fuel spent squeezing 5000 shorts, higher low failing to expand. Fading strength for reversion toward 9698 then 9600 into close.
